title: Sophia A.:
headline: Playing with classmates builds her self-esteem. The multitasking and the fast times finally made division click.
story: Sophia says working with her class helps her build self-esteem and communicate. That is the line no other kid in the set says.
Math was boring and she did not really understand it. Now she does: division clicked because of the multitasking and the fast times. She made new friends too.

Loops: L1 “How does a board game build self-esteem?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:20 (“the fast times helped me”). L2 “Did she make friends?” opens at 0:31 and closes on “really nice”. Stakes: a kid who did not understand math.
do: Open on “build self-esteem” with the hook text already on screen.
Cut the long pause after “helps me to like build” (about 1.5 s).
Put <q>division</q> on screen when she says it.
End on “they were really nice”, then the Donate end card.
dont: Do not use B-roll where a girl could be mistaken for Sophia (the girl with glasses in C5244). Use the group shots in this plan.
Do not use the school name the student says at the start.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

checklist: Frame 1 is the speaker with the hook text already on screen. No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
